details.root_cause: @shopify/shopify-app-session-storage-postgresql's PostgreSQLSessionStorage builds its own pg.Pool from manually destructured DATABASE_URL fields (host/user/password/database/port) and NEVER reads the URL's query string - so ?sslmode=require in DATABASE_URL is silently ignored. The library has no ssl/dialectOptions parameter in its public API. pg's own fallback then checks PGSSLMODE env var, which is unset anywhere in this repo, defaulting to ssl:false - a plaintext connection attempt against Neon, which requires SSL and rejects it. This pool is constructed eagerly at module load and awaited on every authenticate.admin() call, explaining why the error is identical and universal, not intermittent.
details.immediate_fix_no_code_change: Set PGSSLMODE=no-verify in Vercel environment variables (Production + Preview), redeploy. Uses pg's own env-var SSL fallback, matches the rejectUnauthorized:false posture already proven working in db/config/config.cjs's production block.
